g.text: Angle of attack 4 degrees | aspect ratio 6.576 | NASA TP-3151, Fig. 21(a)
NASA: Re = 1.5 million, square tip, uncorrected tunnel measurements. Solver: inviscid free air.
Square-tip diagnostic uses span-Q2; rounded tip uses tensor-Q2. Geometry and method both differ.
Rounding intervals are not experimental uncertainty. This is a comparison, not an experimental pass.
